{{Short description|Soviet and Russian mathematician}}
'''Valery Denisovich Goppa''' ({{langx|ru|Вале́рий Дени́сович Го́ппа}}; born 1939<ref>Stepan G. Korneev, [https://books.google.com/books?id=_9S4AAAAIAAJ&q=%D0%93%D0%BE%D0%BF%D0%BF%D0%B0,+%D0%92%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%B9+%D0%94%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%81%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87&dq=%D0%93%D0%BE%D0%BF%D0%BF%D0%B0,+%D0%92%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%B9+%D0%94%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%81%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87&ei=0OVsS8qhHInSNKngsIQL&cd=4 Soviet scientists - honorary members of foreign scientific societies.]{{in lang|ru}} Nauka, Moscow, 1981; p. 41</ref>) is a [[USSR|Soviet]] and [[Russia]]n mathematician.

He discovered a relation between [[algebraic geometry]] and codes, utilizing the [[Riemann–Roch theorem|Riemann-Roch theorem]]. Today these codes are called [[Algebraic geometry code|algebraic geometry codes]].<ref>{{cite book |first1=William Cary |last1=Huffman |first2=Vera S. |last2=Pless |author-link2=Vera Pless |title=Fundamentals of Error-Correcting Codes |publisher=[[Cambridge University Press]] |year=2003 |isbn=978-0-521-78280-7 |id=0-521-78280-5 |page=521 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=wzPgDaJzJL4C&pg=PA521 |access-date=2016-02-02}}</ref> In 1981 he presented his discovery at the algebra seminar of the [[Moscow State University]].

He also constructed other classes of codes in his career, and in 1972 he won the best paper award of the [[IEEE Information Theory Society]] for his paper "A new class of linear correcting codes".<ref>{{cite web |title=Information Theory Society Paper Award |url=http://www.itsoc.org/honors/information-theory-paper-award |publisher=[[IEEE Information Theory Society]] |access-date={{Format date|2013|3|6}}}}</ref> It is this class of codes that bear the name of “[[Binary Goppa code|Goppa code]]”.
